name: ERGO Insurance Hub
desc:
🌟 Are you ready to become the ultimate policy pro? 🌟

Join the group to be the first to know when there are new updates.
In "ERGO Insurance Hub" you start as a rookie and fight your way through exciting knowledge games from the world of insurance. Show off your skills, collect stars and unlock one level after another!

💡 What to expect:

• 🚀 Level-Up Adventure: From Rookie to Policy Pro, level up by completing tricky challenges and expanding your knowledge about insurances. 

• 🧩 Interactive mini-games: Learn a lot of new things about insurance in a playful way. Become a pro at health, risk and house insurance!

• 🎴Game cards: There are 13 game cards hidden all over the insurance world of ERGO! Can you find them all?

Be the hero of your own insurance story – because knowledge makes you strong! 💪

A Roblox game developed by ERGO Group AG.
